parole.significato: anorak (a heavy weatherproof jacket with an attached hood; a parka or windcheater)
parole.testo: Internationalism chiefly via German Anorak. Ultimately from Greenlandic annoraaq, possibly related to Greenlandic anori (“wind”). The Greenlandic term is from Greenlandic *atnuʀaaq (“clothing”), cognate with Inuktitut ᐊᓐᓄᕌᑦ (annoraat, “clothing”). First attested in 1941.
